# Vendored dependency

`py2Dmol.embed.min.js` is the WebGL2 embed bundle from
[sokrypton/py2Dmol](https://github.com/sokrypton/py2Dmol) by Sergey Ovchinnikov,
downloaded from <https://py2dmol.solab.org/py2Dmol/resources/bundles/py2Dmol.embed.min.js>.

It is checked in rather than loaded from a CDN so the published site has no
third-party script dependency at runtime. To update it, download that URL again.
